title: Go and Gin
overview: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Go (Golang) and its powerful web framework Gin, enabling participants to build high-performance, scalable, and secure web applications and APIs. Through hands-on projects, participants will learn Go programming fundamentals, how to develop RESTful APIs, implement middleware, authentication, database integration, and deploy production-ready applications using Gin.
audience: Software Developers looking to learn Go for web development
Backend Developers interested in high-performance API development
Full-Stack Developers who want to expand their skill set with Go
DevOps Engineers working with microservices and cloud applications
Students & Professionals seeking a career in modern web development
methodology: Hands-on Coding Labs – Writing Go applications with Gin from scratch
Live Demonstrations – Implementing real-world use cases
Case Studies & Best Practices – Learning from industry scenarios
Collaborative Learning – Group discussions and peer reviews
Capstone Project – Developing a fully functional API with Go and Gin
competencies: Building Web Applications using the Gin Framework
Developing RESTful APIs with Go and Gin
Deploying Scalable Go Applications in Production
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the fundamentals of Go and the Gin framework
Build web applications and RESTful APIs using Gin
Implement authentication, middleware, and security best practices
Work with databases using GORM and SQL
Optimize and deploy high-performance web applications with Gin

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Go & Web Development

items.text: What is Go? – Overview, Features, and Benefits
Setting up the Go Development Environment

outline.title: Module 2: Getting Started with the Gin Framework

items.text: What is Gin? – Features and Benefits

Handling Requests, Responses, and Query Parameters
Working with JSON Data & Serialization

outline.title: Module 3: Middleware & Request Handling in Gin

items.text: What is Middleware? Built-in vs. Custom Middleware
Logging & Error Handling with Gin
Implementing Authentication Middleware (JWT, OAuth2)
Managing CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing)
Rate Limiting and Performance Optimization

Protecting APIs with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

Monitoring and Logging in Production Environments
